reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering minerals, Slime eggs, fish, summer crops, prepared foods, rings, torches, and tortillas were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish and Slime names, crop timing and repeat harvests, mineral terminology, gameplay effects, food context, object gender, caution wording, and culinary loanword preservation; both found no remaining objective issue.

ThunderEgg_Description.source: According to legend, angry thunder spirits would throw these stones at one another.
ThunderEgg_Description.translation: Potrivit legendei, spiritele furioase ale tunetului aruncau aceste pietre unele în altele.

Tigerseye_Description.source: A stripe of shimmering gold gives this gem a warm luster.
Tigerseye_Description.translation: O dungă aurie sclipitoare îi conferă acestei nestemate un luciu cald.

TigerSlimeEgg_Description.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator. Use with extreme caution!
TigerSlimeEgg_Description.translation: Poate ecloza într-un Incubator de Slime. Folosește-l cu extremă precauție!

TigerTrout_Description.source: A rare hybrid trout that cannot bear offspring of its own.
TigerTrout_Description.translation: Un păstrăv hibrid rar care nu poate avea urmași.

Tilapia_Name.preservationReason: Tilapia is the standard Romanian fish name with the same spelling as the English source.

Tilapia_Description.source: A primarily vegetarian fish that prefers warm water.
Tilapia_Description.translation: Un pește în principal vegetarian, care preferă apa caldă.

Tomato_Description.source: Rich and slightly tangy, the Tomato has a wide variety of culinary uses.
Tomato_Description.translation: Cu un gust bogat și ușor acrișor, roșia are numeroase întrebuințări culinare.

TomatoSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 11 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
TomatoSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara. Ajung la maturitate în 11 zile și continuă să producă după prima recoltă.

Topaz_Name.preservationReason: Topaz is the standard Romanian mineral name with the same spelling as the English source.

Topaz_Description.source: Fairly common but still prized for its beauty.
Topaz_Description.translation: Destul de comun, dar încă prețuit pentru frumusețea sa.

TopazRing_Description.source: You feel a little bit safer wearing this.
TopazRing_Description.translation: Te simți puțin mai în siguranță când îl porți.

Torch_Description.source: Provides a modest amount of light.
Torch_Description.translation: Oferă o cantitate modestă de lumină.

Tortilla_Name.preservationReason: Tortilla is the standard Romanian culinary loanword with the same spelling as the English source.

Tortilla_Description.source: Can be used as a vessel for food or eaten by itself.
Tortilla_Description.translation: Poate servi drept înveliș pentru mâncare sau poate fi consumată simplă.
